name: Agent Red Teaming Benchmark
intro: Agent Red Teaming（ART）Benchmark 从 Gray Swan 公开挑战赛的 180 万次攻击提交中，经更严格的 LLM 评审与按行为-模型组合采样，筛选出覆盖 44 个部署场景的 4,700 条高质量提示注入，用于评估 Agent 的策略违规风险与攻击迁移性。
org: Gray Swan AI, UK AI Security Institute
build_method: 公开红队挑战赛采集, 严格LLM评审筛选, 分层采样
metric: 行为级攻击成功率 ASR@k（k=1/10/100）, 攻击迁移率
eval_feature: 直接与间接提示注入, 多查询预算, 跨模型迁移与通用性分析
scale: 4,700条精选攻击, 44个目标行为（源自180万次提交与6万+成功违规）
build_method_en: Public red-team challenge collection, stricter LLM-judge filtering, stratified sampling
eval_feature_en: Direct and indirect prompt injection, multi-query budgets, cross-model transfer and universality analysis
intro_en: The Agent Red Teaming (ART) Benchmark filters 1.8 million submissions from Gray Swan's public challenge with a stricter LLM judge, then samples by behavior-model pair to produce 4,700 high-quality prompt injections across 44 deployment settings for evaluating policy violations and attack transferability.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2507.20526v1 Sections 2.1-2.3, Section 3.2, and the Appendix judging prompt. Four challenge waves over 22 anonymized agents produced about 1.8M submissions and over 62,000 successful policy violations; stricter LLM re-judging and up to five attacks per behavior-model pair yield 4,700 attacks across 44 behaviors. The source explicitly plans to publicly release test cases while retaining a private dynamic leaderboard to limit overfitting and misuse; actual public benchmark release was not verified in this source revision.
